features.name: Message - prompt with custom message
features.description: Scenario 1 lets the user enter a Message and Target, then click Launch to invoke CredentialPicker.PickAsync with a message. Results (Domain, Username, Password, CredentialSaved, CheckboxState, Status) are displayed.
expected_behaviour: Message and Target TextBoxes are present with default text 'Enter your credentials' and 'contoso.com'
A Launch button is present and clicking it invokes the credential picker (produces a visible response / status output)
Result fields Domain, Username, Password, CredentialSaved, CheckboxState, Status are present

features.name: Message+Caption - prompt with message and caption
features.description: Scenario 2 adds a Caption TextBox to the Message/Target inputs. Launch invokes PickAsync with both message and caption.
expected_behaviour: Message, Caption and Target TextBoxes are present
A Launch button is present and invokes the credential picker

features.name: CredentialPickerOptions - full options
features.description: Scenario 3 exposes SaveCheckboxSelection and ProtocolSelection ComboBoxes, a CustomProtocol TextBox, an AlwaysShowDialog CheckBox, plus Message/Caption/Target inputs and Launch. ProtocolSelection has a SelectionChanged handler.
expected_behaviour: SaveCheckboxSelection and ProtocolSelection ComboBoxes are present
CustomProtocol TextBox and AlwaysShowDialog CheckBox are present
A Launch button is present and invokes the credential picker with the chosen options
